name: Sourav Mitra
conditions: Heart failure with reduced ejection fraction

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: independent in ADLs, walks 2 km daily, tailoring work fine. cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (negative). falls: 0 falls in last 12 months, gait steady, TUG 10 seconds (normal). medicines: 8 regular (levocetirizine 5 mg OD, cetirizine 10 mg HS, methylcobalamin 1500 mcg OD, sacubitril/valsartan 24/26 mg BD, bisoprolol 2.5 mg OD, spironolactone 25 mg OD, furosemide 40 mg OD, dapagliflozin 10 mg OD) – polypharmacy, request Beers review. mood: reports good spirits, denies depression. carers: wife Priya, spouse. goals: "Stay active and keep stitching for my grandchildren."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: CBC: Hb 13.2 g/L (13-18), WBC 6.2 x10^9/L, eosinophils 0.4 x10^9/L (0.0-0.5). TFT: TSH 2.1 mIU/L (0.4-4.0), FT4 13.5 pmol/L (9-18). Serum B12 210 pg/mL (200-900). MCV 92 fL (80-100). Serum K 4.3 mmol/L (3.5-5.0). Creatinine 110 µmol/L (60-110). NT-proBNP 850 pg/mL (<400 normal, elevated).

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Echocardiogram: LVEF 35% (mild-moderately reduced), LVSD, NYHA class II. No significant valve disease. IVC collapsible >50% with sniff.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: ADL independent, occasional knee pain after long standing, still tailoring. cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5 (stable). falls: 0 falls, gait slightly antalgic left knee, TUG 11 seconds (borderline). medicines: 8 regular, added levocetirizine PRN for urticaria flare, stopped cetirizine due to daytime sedation. mood: mild anxiety about medication load. carers: wife Priya. goals: "Keep working without pain and avoid hospital trips."

memories.author: D06
memories.text:

bisoprolol 1.25 mg OD (reduced)
spironolactone 25 mg OD
furosemide 40 mg OD

memories.author: lab
memories.text: CBC: Hb 13.0 g/L, WBC 5.9, eosinophils 0.3. TFT: TSH 2.0, FT4 13.2. Serum B12 260 pg/mL (up). MCV 91 fL. K 4.2. Creatinine 108. NT-proBNP 720 pg/mL (down).

memories.author: front_desk
memories.text: Booked follow‑up geriatric review for 2025-10-15 at 10:00 with Dr Nandini Kulkarni (D06).

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: ADL independent, tailoring 4 hrs/day, reports mild dyspnea on exertion (stairs). cognition: Mini-Cog 4/5. falls: 0 falls, gait normal, TUG 10 seconds. medicines: 7 regular (stopped levocetirizine PRN as urticaria controlled, continued bisoprolol 1.25 mg). mood: reports occasional low mood, denies anhedonia. carers: wife Priya. goals: "Stay out of the hospital and keep my shop open."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: CBC: Hb 12.8 g/L, WBC 6.0, eosinophils 0.2. TFT: TSH 2.2, FT4 13.0. Serum B12 340 pg/mL (within normal). MCV 90 fL. K 4.1. Creatinine 115 µmol/L (mild rise). NT-proBNP 610 pg/mL (declining).

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Exercise treadmill test (Bruce protocol): stopped at stage 2 due to fatigue and mild dyspnea, achieved 5 METs, no ischemic ECG changes, BP response appropriate. Interpretation: reduced functional capacity consistent with HF.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: ADL independent, tailoring 3 hrs/day, reports increased leg swelling evenings. cognition: Mini-Cog 3/5 (borderline, plan formal assessment). falls: 1 fall at home (tripped over rug) no injury, gait slow, TUG 14 seconds (raised risk). medicines: 7 regular, added furosemide 20 mg extra OD for edema, continued bisoprolol 1.25 mg. mood: tearful, worries about dependence. carers: wife Priya. goals: "Avoid another fall and keep walking to market."

memories.author: patient
memories.text: Message via clinic app: "Doctor, my feet are swollen and I feel short of breath after walking to the bus stop. I’m worried I’m getting worse."

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Referral to cardiology for optimization of HFrEF and consideration of device therapy. Include recent echo EF 35%, NT-proBNP trend, and medication list.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: Cardiology review: patient on guideline‑directed medical therapy, EF stable 35%, NYHA II‑III. Recommend continue current meds, add ivabradine 5 mg BD if heart rate >70, monitor electrolytes. No device indicated at present.

memories.author: D06
memories.text: function: ADL independent with occasional assistance for heavy lifting, tailoring 2 hrs/day. cognition: Mini-Cog 3/5 (still borderline, awaiting formal assessment). falls: 1 fall in last 12 months, gait cautious, TUG 13 seconds (raised risk). medicines: 8 regular (added ivabradine 5 mg BD per cardiology advice). mood: reports improved sleep, less anxiety. carers: wife Priya. goals: "Stay on my feet and see my great‑grandchildren grow."
